title: Decompose, Don't Expand: Capability-Independent AI Systems by Construction
abstract: arXiv:2610.38144v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: A recurring design choice in building AI systems is whether, when a task is too hard for a model, to expand the model (make it larger, better-prompted, fine-tuned), or to decompose the task (extract the parts that admit a deterministic solution to a host, leaving the model only the irreducibly fuzzy residue). We make three claims. First, that many tasks commonly delegated whole to a model are in fact deterministic tasks with a small generative core. Second, and our central empirical result, that decomposing such a task yields a measurable and desirable property we call parity by construction: on the extracted sub-tasks the model-size performance curve becomes flat, because no model performs them at all. translated_title: 分解而非扩展：通过构造实现能力无关的AI系统
translated_abstract: 构建AI系统时一个反复出现的设计选择是：当任务对模型而言过于困难时，是扩展模型（使其更大、提示更好、进行微调），还是分解任务（将可确定性求解的部分提取给宿主处理，仅将无法再化简的模糊残余留给模型）。我们提出三个论点。第一，许多通常被整体委托给模型的任务，实际上是仅包含小型生成核心的确定性任务。第二，也是我们的核心实证结果：分解此类任务会产生一个可度量且理想的属性，我们称之为“构造平价性”：在被提取的子任务上，模型规模与性能的曲线变得平坦，因为这些任务根本不由任何模型执行。我们在九个模型上进行了测量，范围涵盖从494M参数的本地检查点到前沿的Opus级模型，仅在本地系列上就跨越了三十倍的参数范围：一旦宿主解析了上下文，操作选择的得分便完全一致……
tldr: 该论文提出当任务对模型太难时，应将任务分解、把可确定性求解的部分交由宿主处理，而非一味扩展模型，从而使系统性能与模型规模无关（即“构造平价性”），并在跨越30倍参数范围的九个模型上通过实证验证了这一结论。
en_tdlr: The paper argues that when a task is too hard for a model, one should decompose it—extracting deterministic parts to a host—rather than expand the model, yielding a measurable property called "parity by construction" where performance becomes flat across model sizes, empirically validated across nine models spanning a thirty-fold parameter range.
